ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white fields on both lobes. The left lobe contains vertical low-intensity streaks radiating from the peduncle. The right lobe exhibits dense, disorganized low-intensity mottling and vertical linear disruptions concentrated in the lower and outer quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees with a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated profile; continuous peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes increasing toward the lateral tips; ragged texture throughout the boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curvature originating from the notch and terminating in slightly hooked, dorsally-oriented lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters and irregular surface textures concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel and unaligned vertical dark linear streaks crossing the high-intensity white regions on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion and ragged material loss at the distal lateral tips of both lobes, suggesting previous trauma or extensive colonization.
